title: Improper shell quote escaping when processing user-controlled input, potentially allowing command… (CVE-2026-63282)
description: CVE-2026-63282 is a vulnerability involving improper shell quote escaping when processing user-controlled input. This flaw could allow command injection, potentially leading to privilege escalation. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating medium severity. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
